metadata.title: Medicare Part D Prescribers — by Geography and Drug
metadata.scope: Medicare Part D claims for records with generic name Sildenafil Citrate
notes: Sildenafil Citrate includes brand and generic records; it is not synonymous with Viagra.
The source is Medicare Part D, not all prescriptions in the United States.
Blank source values are treated as unavailable and excluded from totals for that field.
